register.reg_long_name: Counter-timer Secure Physical Timer Control Register (EL2)
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_AA32 is implemented and FEAT_SEL2 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Provides AArch32 access from EL0 to the Secure EL2 physical timer.

reg_bank.bank_text: This register is banked between CNTHPS_CTL and CNTHPS_CTL_S and CNTHPS_CTL_NS.

attributes_text.para: This register has the following instances:

listitem.content: CNTHPS_CTL, when EL3 is not implemented or FEAT_AA64 is implemented.

field_description.para: The status of the timer. This bit indicates whether the timer condition is met:

When the value of the CNTHPS_CTL.ENABLE bit is 1, ISTATUS indicates whether the timer condition is met. ISTATUS takes no account of the value of the IMASK bit. If the value of ISTATUS is 1 and the value of IMASK is 0 then the timer interrupt is asserted.
When the value of the CNTHPS_CTL.ENABLE bit is 0, the ISTATUS field is UNKNOWN.
Timer interrupt mask bit. Permitted values are:
For more information, see the description of the ISTATUS bit.

field_value_description.para: Timer interrupt is not masked by the IMASK bit.
Timer interrupt is masked by the IMASK bit.

field_description.para: Enables the timer. Permitted values are:
Setting this bit to 0 disables the timer output signal, but the timer value accessible from CNTHPS_TVAL continues to count down.

note.para: Disabling the output signal might be a power-saving option.

access_permission_text.para: This register is accessed using the encoding for CNTP_CTL.
